description: This Java class serves as a handler for processing 'Release Amount' commands on savings accounts within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and coordinates with the 'SavingsAccountWritePlatformService' to carry out the release operation within a transactional context.

classes.name: ReleaseAmountSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles release amount commands for savings accounts, executing the operation through the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to release amount on savings account by invoking the write platform service. Executes within a transactional scope.
